language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I’m Chip.
Hello, my name is Louis. Welcome to Rio de Janeiro, the Carnival Capital of the World!
Look here, the kids are shooting ducks. Let us ask them the number of ducks they shot then display them on a graph.
So, how will you display these on a picture graph? Let’s label the axes of the graph.
Now, let us display the data on the graph.
This data will help us create a column graph. Let us make the Y and X axis first.
Now, let us name the axes with the titles mentioned in the table. We can name the axes randomly.
So, name Y axis as Number of Ducks Shot and X axis as Name. Now is the time to create the graph.
We will place the ducks under each name according to the number of ducks shots.
Let us start with David. He has shot 5 ducks. So, place 5 ducks in David’s column.
Place the number of shot ducks by the other participants under their names, too.
Can you answer some questions on the basis of this column graph?
Who shot the highest number of ducks?
Sydney! Correct, because the highest bar is under her name.
A graph can help you find answers in seconds.
I am enjoying the festival. Hey, look a wheel of fortune.
Want to try your luck? Before we do, let's check the chances of the appearance of 1000 in 5 turns first.
So, in 5 turns, there are 2 chances of appearance of 1000.
therefore, the probability of appearance of 1000 in 5 chance is 2/5.
Aren’t these methods interesting? Let us try them at the carnival party.
